content.value: The [[article/fletching|Fletching Table]] handles its assigned ranged equipment and supported ammunition recipes. It shares material search, category tabs, Craftable and batch quantities with the other assembly stations.
Only supported arrow types are part of the mod system. Ammunition recipes use their assigned components; discovering all required ingredients reveals an ordinary recipe.
Read [[article/ranged_weapons|Bows and Crossbows]] for the draw, reload, aim and firing controls. The actual recipe list reflects the crafts you have discovered.
